WO_GROUP_ARCHIVED: That work order group is archived. Choose another.
WPVA_PLAN_CANCELLED: This work order is cancelled, so its plan cannot change.
WPVA_PLAN_DISCIPLINE: That discipline is no longer on your organisation's list.
WPVA_PLAN_KEY: A plan figure keeps its work order, discipline and kind. Add a new figure instead.
WPVA_PLAN_WO: That work order belongs to another project.
WPVA_SPLIT_PERCENT: Each percentage is from 0 to 100, with up to 4 decimals.
WPVA_SPLIT_ROLE: Only an Admin, Executive or Finance user sets a shared-cost split.
WPVA_SPLIT_SHAPE: Name each work order once in the split.
WPVA_SPLIT_SUM: The percentages add up to {{sum}}. They must add up to 100.
WPVA_SPLIT_WORK_ORDERS: The split must name every live work order of this project, and only those.
WRP_AMOUNT: An amount is zero or more, with at most two decimals.
WRP_FROZEN: This work order is closed or cancelled, so its plan is frozen.
WRP_KEPT_EXCEEDS: The days you kept already add up to more than the month amount.
WRP_NO_WORKING_DAY: The month has no free working day on this work order.
WRP_OFF: The revenue plan is not switched on for this organisation.
WRP_RANGE: Choose a range of at most two years.
WRP_ROLE: You cannot see revenue on this project.
WRP_SETTINGS: Choose one to seven different weekdays, 1 for Monday to 7 for Sunday.
ORDER_NEEDS_SUPPLIER_detail: An order needs its supplier. Choose it, then record the order.
WO_AREA: That check-in area is not valid
WO_AREA_detail: Give a latitude from -90 to 90, a longitude from -180 to 180 and a radius above 0 up to 50,000 metres, or leave all three empty.
MR_NO_MANAGER: This person has no direct manager, so nobody can decide a release. Set their direct manager first, then open the release.
ATT_FOLLOW_LOCKED: These hours are already submitted or approved. Correct them through the timesheet correction path.
ATT_FOLLOW_NONE: No follow is recorded for this person that day. Reload to see the current roster.
ATT_FOLLOW_RECORDED: This person is already recorded present on another work order that day. Ask their own crew's recorder, or a crew manager, to correct it first.
HC_CLASS: Choose a labour class that is still in use, then save the head count again.
HC_COUNT: A head count is a whole number from 1 to 500. Enter a number in that range.
HC_CREW_NOT_ROSTERED: That crew is not on this work order on that date. Choose a crew that is, or add the crew to the work order first.
HC_DATE_FUTURE: A head count cannot be recorded for a future date. Choose today or an earlier day.
HC_DATE_OLD: The earliest date open for a head count is {{date}}. Ask an Admin if an earlier day must be recorded.
HC_LOCKED: This head count is approved and final. Ask an Admin or Finance if it must be corrected.
SVY_FROZEN: This survey is confirmed or discarded and cannot be changed.
SVY_FROZEN_detail: To correct a confirmed survey, record a new survey that corrects it.
SVY_NOT_FOUND: That survey or work order was not found.
SVY_NOT_FOUND_detail: Refresh the page and try again.
SVY_NOT_ISSUED: Surveys are recorded and confirmed only while the work order is issued.
SVY_NOT_ISSUED_detail: Issue the work order first, or ask the person who manages it.
SVY_NOT_PERMITTED: You cannot record or change a survey on this project.
SVY_NOT_PERMITTED_detail: Ask the project manager, Finance or an Admin to record it.
SVY_BAD_QUANTITY: Enter a date and quantities that are zero or more, with at most 3 decimals.
SVY_QUALITY_OVER: The quality-ready quantity cannot be more than the surveyed quantity.
SVY_QUALITY_OVER_detail: Lower the quality-ready quantity, or raise the surveyed quantity.
SVY_NEEDS_PARTICIPANT: Record who took part in the survey.
SVY_NEEDS_PARTICIPANT_detail: Add at least one person with a name. A company and role are optional.
SVY_NOT_ALLOCATED: This contract line is not allocated to the work order.
SVY_NOT_ALLOCATED_detail: Allocate the line to the work order first, or pick another line.
SVY_LUMP_SUM: A survey is recorded on a unit-rate line, not a lump-sum line.
SVY_NOT_CORRECTABLE: Only a confirmed survey of the same line that has not already been corrected can be corrected.
SVY_ALREADY_CORRECTED: A correction of this survey is already open.
SVY_ALREADY_CORRECTED_detail: Confirm or discard the open correction first.
SVY_DOCUMENT_INVALID_detail: Choose an issued or approved document with a file from this work order's project.
SVY_CONFIRM_ROLE: Only Finance or an Admin can confirm a survey.
SVY_CONFIRM_ROLE_detail: Ask Finance or an Admin to confirm it.
SVY_RECORDER_CONFIRMS: The person who recorded a survey cannot confirm it.
SVY_RECORDER_CONFIRMS_detail: Ask Finance or an Admin other than the recorder to confirm it.
WBS_HIDDEN_ASSIGNEE: Only Finance or an Admin can name a person this step is hidden from.
WBS_HIDDEN_ASSIGNEE_detail: Ask Finance or an Admin to name that person, or choose someone else.
SVY_NEEDS_SHEET: Attach the survey sheet before confirming this survey.
SVY_NEEDS_SHEET_detail: Attach the signed or recorded survey sheet (and any quality documents), then confirm.
CLR_DOC_TYPE: Choose one of your document types for people.
OPN_NOT_ADMIN: Only an Admin can load opening stock. Ask an Admin to do it.
OPN_ROW_INVALID: A cell in this row is not valid. Check the date, direction and quantity against the template, then choose the file again.
OPN_ROW_INVALID_figures: Row {{row}} has a cell that is not valid. Check its date, direction and quantity against the template, then choose the file again.
OPN_UNKNOWN_ITEM: This item code is not in your stock items. Add the item in Stock set-up or correct the code, then choose the file again.
OPN_UNKNOWN_ITEM_figures: Row {{row}}: this item code is not in your stock items. Add the item in Stock set-up or correct the code, then choose the file again.
OPN_UNKNOWN_LOCATION: This location code is not in your stock locations. Add the location in Stock set-up or correct the code, then choose the file again.
OPN_UNKNOWN_LOCATION_figures: Row {{row}}: this location code is not in your stock locations. Add the location in Stock set-up or correct the code, then choose the file again.
OPN_COST_NEEDED: This item is bought, so an in row needs a unit cost. Add the cost, then choose the file again.
OPN_COST_NEEDED_figures: Row {{row}}: this item is bought, so an in row needs a unit cost. Add the cost, then choose the file again.
OPN_OVER_ISSUE: This out row is larger than what is on hand on its date. Check the dates and quantities, or add the missing in row, then choose the file again.
OPN_OVER_ISSUE_figures: Row {{row}}: this out row is larger than what is on hand on its date. Check the dates and quantities, or add the missing in row, then choose the file again.
OPN_DATE_AFTER_GO_LIVE: This row is dated after the go-live date. Correct the date or move the go-live date, then choose the file again.
OPN_DATE_AFTER_GO_LIVE_figures: Row {{row}} is dated after the go-live date. Correct the date or move the go-live date, then choose the file again.
OPN_LOCATION_MOVED: This location already has stock movements, so it can no longer take an opening. Count it instead, or ask for the first movement to be reversed.
OPN_LOCATION_MOVED_figures: Row {{row}}: this location already has stock movements, so it can no longer take an opening. Count it instead, or ask for the first movement to be reversed.
OPN_ALREADY_LOADED: This location already has an opening. Reverse that opening first, then load the corrected file.
OPN_ALREADY_LOADED_figures: Row {{row}}: this location already has an opening. Reverse that opening first, then load the corrected file.
OPN_TOO_MANY_ROWS: A file holds 1 to 5,000 rows. Split it by location and load each part.
STK_ZERO_COST_figures: Row {{row}}: this item is client-supplied, so it is received at zero cost. Leave the unit cost blank or write 0, then choose the file again.
ABS_NOTE: The note is too long. Shorten it and send again.
ABS_PERSON: This account is not linked to a person on a crew, so absence cannot be reported. Ask your supervisor.
PPL_MANAGER_RIGHT: Only an Admin or the people team (HR) can set or change a person's direct manager.
PPL_MANAGER_SELF: Only an Admin can make themselves a person's direct manager. Choose another manager, or ask an Admin.
ATT_SECOND_SELF: This is your own working day. Ask another person who enters second records to add one.
ATT_DECIDE_SELF: This is your own working day. Another person your organisation named, or an Admin, decides which hours stand.
MR_SOD_DECIDER: You are this person's direct manager, so you could never decide a release you open. Ask an Admin to open it, or set another direct manager first.
MR_WITHDRAW_RIGHT: Only an Admin or the people team (HR) can withdraw a release.
MR_WITHDRAW_SELF: You cannot withdraw your own release. Ask an Admin or someone else in the people team.
MR_WITHDRAW_REASON: Say why the release is withdrawn, in up to 500 characters.
MR_REASSIGN_RIGHT: Only an Admin can move a release to another manager.
MR_DECIDER_ACTIVE: The manager who decides this release is still active. Ask them to decide it.
MR_REASSIGN_NO_MANAGER: This person has no active direct manager. Set one on their person record, then move the release.
MR_REASSIGN_SOD: The person's current manager opened this release, or is the person. Set another direct manager first, then move it.
LCM_HAS_LOGIN: This person signs in, so their hours are costed on their timesheet. A class is only for people with no login.
TASK_TREE_CYCLE: A task cannot sit under one of its own subtasks.
COT_OWNER_ROLE: Choose a job role as this item's owner.
CTR_OWN_REPORT: You reported this tool, so someone else writes it off.
DCV_ADMIN: The Administrator always sees every category.
PRC_STOCK_ITEM: Choose an active item from your organisation's item list.
PRC_SUPPLIER_FORBIDDEN: Only a purchasing manager or a person who orders purchases names the supplier.
PRC_SUPPLIER_INVALID: Choose an active supplier of your organisation.
PRC_SUPPLIER_SET: This purchase already names its supplier.
PRC_SUPPLIER_STEP: Name the supplier once the purchase is approved.
PPL_PROFILE_SELF: Only an Admin can link or unlink their own person record.
RGO_EXTERNAL: Continue receiving in your accounting system: PMO must own purchasing and inventory.
RGO_MAPPING_ROLE: Only a purchasing user can map an order line to stock.
RGO_MAPPING_FROZEN: This line has a receipt count; its stock item cannot change.
RGO_STOCK_ITEM: Choose an active stock item in this organisation.
RGO_OFF: Receiving against an order is off.
RGO_ORDER_STATE: Choose an approved, sent order for stock goods.
RGO_COUNTS: Enter counted quantities for at least one order line.
RGO_REFERENCE: This receipt reference already belongs to another count.
RGO_FIELDS: Enter only the order line and counted quantity.
RGO_QUANTITY: Enter a positive counted quantity with at most three decimals.
RGO_UNMAPPED: This line follows the service or direct-use receiving path.
RGO_APPROVAL: A different purchasing user must approve this excess.
RGO_REASON: Give a reason for accepting the excess.
RGO_READ_ROLE: Receiving is for warehouse keepers and purchasing users.
RGO_IMMUTABLE: An order receipt is immutable; record a reversing movement.
RGO_SETTING_ROLE: Only an Admin changes receiving settings.
RGO_REVERSE_ROLE: A different purchasing user must reverse this receipt.
RGO_REVERSE_REASON: Give a reason for reversing this receipt.
RGO_USE_ORDER: Receive these goods against their purchase order.
RGO_BLIND_COPY: Enter your own request quantities; a blind receiver cannot copy ordered quantities.
RGO_APPROVAL_IMMUTABLE: Excess approval snapshots cannot be changed.
SR_LINK: Link a site report to one crew or to one person, not both, and choose one from your organisation.
HCE_DOCUMENT: Choose a file that belongs to this work order's project and has a file attached.
HCE_LIMIT: A head count carries at most 10 files. Remove one first.
AREA_UNKNOWN: Choose an area from your organisation's list.
AREA_RATE: Enter a rate above zero, or clear the field to remove the area's rate.
AREA_RATE_CATALOGUE: This line is priced from the rate catalogue, so its rate comes from the catalogue, not from an area.
WBS_ORDER_NOT_FOUND: That work order is not available. Refresh the page and try again.
WBS_STEP_ADD_RIGHT: Only a person who runs billing steps can add a step to this checklist.
WBS_STEP_ADD_RIGHT_detail: Ask the person who runs the billing steps, or an Admin or Finance person.
WBS_STEP_ADD_PM: Only the project's manager can add a step to this checklist.
WBS_STEP_NAME: Name the step, in up to 120 characters.
WBS_STEP_ROLE: Choose an owner role from the organisation's role list. A field account cannot own a step.
WBS_STEP_DAYS: A step target is a whole number of days, 1 to 365.
WBS_STEP_SHAPE: This checklist has at most 20 steps, and a new step needs a place in the list.
WBS_STEP_CLOSED: A new step goes after the current step.
WBS_STEP_CLOSED_detail: Finished and current steps stay where they are.
WBS_CHECKLIST_SETTING: Only Finance or an Admin can switch checklist editing on or off.
WBS_EVIDENCE_MARK: Only an Admin can choose which step documents count as claim evidence.
WBS_CHECKLIST_OFF: Checklist editing is not switched on for this organisation.
WBS_CHECKLIST_OFF_detail: Ask Finance or an Admin to switch it on under billing step templates.
WBS_TEMPLATE_NAME: Name the template, in up to 120 characters.
WBS_TEMPLATE_TAKEN: An active template with this name already exists. Choose another name.
WBS_TEMPLATE_EMPTY: This checklist has no steps to save as a template.
DSR_VALIDATE_ROLE_ADMIN: Only an Admin can change which job roles validate daily site reports.
DSR_VALIDATE_ROLE_INVALID: Choose manager or officer job roles from the built-in list.
DSR_VALIDATE_ROLE_OFF: Turn on built-in roles in Administration > People before naming roles that validate site reports.
IMPORT_EMPTY: There are no work orders in the file.
IMPORT_TOO_MANY: Import at most 500 work orders at a time.
IMPORT_ROW: Row {{row}} was refused, so nothing was imported: {{reason}}
EQ_TERMS_OWNED: Rental terms can only be entered on a rented machine. Ask an Admin to change its ownership first.
SCH_RECIPIENT_FORBIDDEN: Choose active people and roles in your organisation who can read this report.
